The SHOC Zero-G Plus Football Visor is designed to fit all current football helmets on the market, except for the Riddell Axiom. Made from ultra-light, high-grade polycarbonate, it offers maximum breakage strength and superior UV protection, making it one of the safest and most durable visors available.

Key Features:

Unmatched durability: Ultra-light polycarbonate construction with the highest breakage strength in the industry.

UV Protection: Provides excellent protection against harmful UV rays.

Safe & secure fit: Easy installation on a variety of helmet brands and facemask styles.

Compliant with Association Rules: 100% compliant with all major football association regulations.

Helmet Compatibility:

Riddell Speedflex: Fits all factory Speedflex facemask styles, from Adult Extra Large to Youth Small. No fitting issues have been reported, but assistance is available if needed.

Riddell Speed: Works well with several Riddell Speed facemasks, including the newer HS4 models.

Vicis 1 & 2: The Zero-G Plus is compatible with both Vicis helmets. The Vicis 2 may require a few extra installation steps.

Xenith: Compatible with Xenith helmets, including the standard masks and the Alien Prime mask. Longer clips are included as an accessory for a more secure fit.

Light Helmets: No issues reported for fitting on Light Helmets, ensuring an easy installation process.
